name: score-tracker
description: Each game in the app uses a specific scoring type (`scoringType`), which is defined in the `assets/games.json` file. Detailed game behavior rules and element rendering are specified in the `config.json` configuration file inside the game's ZIP archive (e.g., `assets/games/star-realms.zip`).

scripts.version: node sync-version.js && git add service-worker.js assets/games.json
